english.note: Use this when a person or object is inherently or deliberately invisible rather than merely out of sight.

examples.english: Wearing this invisible cloak, I could walk into the crowd unnoticed.
examples.traditional: 着住呢件隱形斗篷，行入人群都冇人睇到我。
